method_card.title: Future Plans and Career Aspirations
method_card.content:
This lesson covers post-16 plans, university, apprenticeships and careers using the conditional and future tense.

FrenchEnglish
le lycéesixth-form / upper secondary school
l'université / la facuniversity
l'apprentissageapprenticeship
le bacbaccalaureate (French qualification, like A-levels)
le bac provocational baccalaureate
quitter l'écoleto leave school
continuer mes étudesto continue my studies
travailler à plein tempsto work full-time
voyagerto travel
l'année sabbatiquegap year
je voudrais / j'aimeraisI would like (conditional)
je vais + infinitiveI am going to (near future)
je ferai / j'irai / je seraiI will do / I will go / I will be (simple future)
si je réussis (Higher)if I pass / if I succeed

Three future structures — use all three for maximum marks:

  • Near future: je vais étudier au lycée (I am going to study at sixth form)
  • Conditional: je voudrais aller à l'université (I would like to go to university)
  • Simple future: je travaillerai comme ingénieur(e) (I will work as an engineer)

Post-16 pathways (UK and French systems): In the UK students may go to sixth form, college, or take an apprenticeship. In France, students study for the bac (general) or bac pro (vocational) before going to l'université (also called la fac informally). An apprentissage (alternance) combines work and study.

Model: Après le brevet, je vais continuer mes études au lycée. J'aimerais passer le bac et ensuite aller à l'université pour étudier la médecine. Si je réussis mes examens, je deviendrai médecin. (After my exams, I am going to continue studying at sixth form. I would like to sit my bac and then go to university to study medicine. If I pass my exams, I will become a doctor.)
steps: Learn post-16 pathway vocabulary for both UK and French systems
Master three future structures: near future (je vais), conditional (je voudrais), simple future (je ferai)
Use all three structures in your writing to show a wide range of language
Practise giving reasons for your choices using parce que, car, and pour + infinitive
Add si clauses (if I pass, if I work hard) for Higher-tier marks

exam_context.frequency: Very high frequency — future plans appear in extended writing, speaking picture tasks and conversation

worked_examples.question: What is the difference between je vais étudier, je voudrais étudier, and j'étudierai?

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Je vais étudier = I am going to study (near future: aller + infinitive). Describes an imminent or planned action.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: Je voudrais étudier = I would like to study (conditional of vouloir). Describes a wish or preference.

steps.label: Step 3
steps.content: J'étudierai = I will study (simple future). Describes a definite future action. Regular -er verbs add endings: -ai, -as, -a, -ons, -ez, -ont to the infinitive.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: Use all three in your writing for variety: je vais (going to), je voudrais (would like), j'étudierai (will study).

worked_examples.question: How do you form the simple future tense for regular -er verbs?

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Take the infinitive: travailler. Add future endings: -ai, -as, -a, -ons, -ez, -ont.

steps.label: Step 3
steps.content: Irregular future stems to know: aller → ir- (j'irai), être → ser- (je serai), avoir → aur- (j'aurai), faire → fer- (je ferai), vouloir → voudr- (je voudrai).

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: Regular -er verbs: infinitive + future ending (-ai, -as, -a…). Irregular stems: ir- (aller), ser- (être), fer- (faire), aur- (avoir).

worked_examples.question: How do you use si (if) clauses with the future tense in French?

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: In French, after si (if) meaning 'if this happens', use the present tense (not future).

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: The result clause (the 'then' part) uses the future tense: Si je réussis (present) mes examens, je serai (future) médecin.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: Si + present tense → result in future: Si je travaille dur, je réussirai. (If I work hard, I will succeed.)

bronze.question: Match the French post-16 vocabulary to the English meaning
Match the French future expressions to the English meaning
Complete the sentence about post-16 plans
sentence_parts: continuer mes études au lycée. Ensuite, je

gaps.correct_explain: vais — je vais continuer = I am going to continue (near future: aller + infinitive).

wrong.voudrais: voudrais = I would like (conditional). Here the sentence says 'going to', so use the near future: je vais.
wrong.va: va is the il/elle form. For je, use vais.

gaps.correct_explain: voudrais = I would like. The second clause expresses a wish, so use the conditional.

wrong.vais: vais is near future. The second clause expresses a wish, so use the conditional: voudrais.

bronze.question: Complete the sentence using the correct future form

gaps.correct_explain: serai = I will be (simple future of être). Irregular stem: ser- + -ai.

wrong.suis: suis is present tense. After quand with future meaning, use the future tense: serai.
wrong.serais: serais is conditional. The future tense ends in -ai: serai.

gaps.correct_explain: travaillerai = I will work. Infinitive travailler + future ending -ai.

wrong.travaille: travaille is present tense. 'I will work' needs the simple future: travaillerai.

bronze.question: What does 'Je vais faire un apprentissage après le collège' mean?
options: I am going to do an apprenticeship after school
I would like to do an apprenticeship after school
I did an apprenticeship after school
I will study at university after school

bronze.question: Which sentence correctly uses the simple future tense?
options: Je vais aller à l'université l'année prochaine.
Je voudrais aller à l'université l'année prochaine.
Je suis allé à l'université l'année prochaine.

bronze.source_text: À l'avenir, je voudrais aller à l'université pour étudier les sciences. Je vais travailler dur pour réussir mes examens.
model_answers: In the future, I would like to go to university to study science. I am going to work hard to pass my exams.

silver.question: Complete the sentence by typing the correct verb form
silver.english: If I pass my exams, I will go to university to study medicine.

gaps.rule: Si clause — present tense after si
gaps.correct_explain: réussis = I pass (present tense). After si (if) with a future condition, French uses the present tense, not the future.

wrong.réussirai: réussirai is the future. After si in a conditional sentence, use the present: réussis.
wrong.réussirais: réussirais is conditional. After si, use the present: réussis.

gaps.correct_explain: irai = I will go (simple future of aller). Irregular stem: ir- + -ai.

wrong.vais: vais is near future. The result clause after si + present needs the simple future: irai.

silver.question: Find and fix the grammatical error
silver.sentence: Après le bac, ma sœur va aller à l'université pour étudier la droit.
silver.explanation: le droit is masculine. La droit is wrong — use le droit (law).
silver.translation: After her bac, my sister is going to go to university to study law.

silver.question: Build the sentence in French
silver.english: I would like to do an apprenticeship because I prefer practical work.

distractor_labels.des: wrong article — apprentissage is singular, needs un not des

silver.source_text: After school, I am going to study at sixth form. I would like to pass my bac and then go to university.
model_answers: Après le collège, je vais étudier au lycée. Je voudrais passer le bac et ensuite aller à l'université.

gold.source_text: After my exams, I am going to study at sixth form for two years. I would like to go to university to study medicine because I would like to help people. If I work hard, I will become a doctor.
model_answers: Après mes examens, je vais étudier au lycée pendant deux ans. Je voudrais aller à l'université pour étudier la médecine parce que j'aimerais aider les gens. Si je travaille dur, je deviendrai médecin.

gold.question: Build the sentence in French
gold.english: The ideal would be to do an apprenticeship because I prefer practical work to studying.

distractor_labels.sera: wrong tense — sera is simple future, but 'would be' needs the conditional: serait
distractor_labels.est: wrong tense — est is present, but 'would be' needs the conditional: serait

gold.question: Role Play
gold.scenario: You are visiting a tourist information office in France on a school exchange trip. The advisor asks about your school and your plans for the future.

bullets.prompt: Say what year you are in at school and describe your timetable briefly.
bullets.model_answer: Je suis en troisième. J'ai dix matières. Les leçons commencent à huit heures trente et finissent à seize heures.
bullets.note: en troisième = Year 10 equivalent; time expressions for timetable

bullets.prompt: Say what you are going to do after school (near future).
bullets.model_answer: Après le collège, je vais continuer mes études au lycée pendant deux ans pour préparer le bac.
bullets.note: near future: je vais + infinitive; pendant + duration; le bac = French A-level equivalent

bullets.prompt: Say what you would like to study at university and why (conditional).
bullets.model_answer: Je voudrais étudier la médecine à l'université parce que j'aimerais devenir médecin et aider les gens.
bullets.note: conditional: voudrais, aimerais; no article before job title after devenir

bullets.prompt: Say where you will work in the future and ask the advisor if there are good career opportunities in France.
bullets.model_answer: À l'avenir, je travaillerai dans un hôpital en France. Est-ce qu'il y a de bonnes opportunités de carrière ici?
bullets.note: simple future: travaillerai; question with est-ce que; requesting information from advisor
